import unreal
cdo=unreal.get_default_object(unreal.NiagaraDataInterfaceRenderTarget2D)
attrs=[n for n in dir(cdo) if 'clear' in n.lower() or 'preview' in n.lower() or 'inherit' in n.lower()]
rows=[]
for di in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.NiagaraDataInterfaceRenderTarget2D):
    p=di.get_path_name()
    if 'NS_SSPR_ProjTest' not in p and 'NiagaraComponent' not in p: continue
    props={}
    for name in attrs:
        try:
            value=di.get_editor_property(name)
            if isinstance(value,(bool,int,float,str)): props[name]=value
            else: props[name]=str(value)
        except Exception: pass
    rows.append({'path':p,'props':props})
print('RT_DI_CLEAR_ATTRS='+repr(attrs))
print('RT_DI_CLEAR_STATE='+repr(rows))
